title: HELIX Bridge: Salesforce → AdmissionApplication
architecture_notes: Agentforce Education uses IndividualApplication with ApplicationDecision; EDA orgs use hed__Application__c. Many schools run applications in Slate or Common App and keep only a summary in Salesforce; map from wherever the system of record is.

source_objects.description: Agentforce Education application record: applicant, program, term, status, submitted date.
EDA application object, for orgs on the managed package.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + IndividualApplication.Id (or hed__Application__c.Id).
Resolve the applicant Contact to HELIX Person, then Student when one exists. VALIDATE which lookup holds the applicant in your org.

attribute_mappings.source: IndividualApplication.Name or an application number field

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map record types or applicant type picklist values (first-year, transfer, graduate, international) through helix/admission application types.

attribute_mappings.source: LearningProgram lookup or hed__Applying_To__c (Academic Program account)

attribute_mappings.transformation: Boolean. Often a local field; VALIDATE.
Common App, institutional app, Slate, and so on.

attribute_mappings.source: Test and GPA fields on the application or a related education history object

extraction_methods.description: Default. SOQL by SystemModstamp high-water mark; queryAll to include deleted rows. Included with API-enabled editions.
Near real-time change events for objects that need freshness. A limited number of objects is included; more needs an add-on. Check your contract.
AWS-managed Salesforce to S3 flows, scheduled or event-triggered. Priced per flow run and data processed on the AWS side.
Only if the institution already licenses Salesforce Data 360. Not required for HELIX.

validate: Object and field names follow Salesforce's published Agentforce Education (formerly Education Cloud), EDA, NPSP, and standard object models, but orgs add custom fields and record types. VALIDATE every field against your org's describe output before building extracts; custom fields end in __c.
